WITH vorherige_laeufe AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
    SET status      = 'abgebrochen',
        finished_at = now(),
        error_text  = 'Durch neuen Angebotsabgleich ersetzt'
    WHERE run_type = 'vollabgleich'
      AND status   = 'laeuft'
)
INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.sync_run (run_type, status)
VALUES ('vollabgleich', 'laeuft')
RETURNING run_id, started_at;

=WITH eingang AS (
    SELECT
        t.*,
        md5(
            concat_ws('|',
                t.name, t.offer_number, t.category_ref, t.place_ref,
                t.date_start::text, t.date_end::text,
                t.user_minimal::text, t.user_maximum::text,
                t.status, t.mode, t.offer_type, t.vat_rate::text,
                t.is_archived::text, t.is_trash::text)
        ) AS payload_hash
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($edoJson${{ $json.datenJson }}$edoJson$::jsonb)
         AS t(
            offer_id             text,
            offer_number         text,
            name                 text,
            category_ref         text,
            offerdef_ref         text,
            place_ref            text,
            date_start           timestamptz,
            date_end             timestamptz,
            date_signupstart     timestamptz,
            date_close           timestamptz,
            user_minimal         integer,
            user_maximum         integer,
            status               text,
            mode                 text,
            offer_type           text,
            vat_rate             numeric(6,3),
            country              text,
            internal_code        text,
            is_archived          boolean,
            is_trash             boolean,
            has_waiting_list     boolean,
            mustpay              boolean,
            is_multi_offer       boolean,
            is_multi_offer_child boolean,
            payload              jsonb
         )
),
kennzahlen AS (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS zeilen,
        count(*) FILTER (
            WHERE o.offer_id IS NULL
               OR o.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM e.payload_hash
        ) AS geaendert
    FROM eingang e
    LEFT JOIN edoobox_raw.offer o ON o.offer_id = e.offer_id
),
geschrieben AS (
    INSERT INTO edoobox_raw.offer AS o (
        offer_id, offer_number, name, category_ref, offerdef_ref, place_ref,
        date_start, date_end, date_signupstart, date_close,
        user_minimal, user_maximum, status, mode, offer_type,
        vat_rate, country, internal_code,
        is_archived, is_trash, has_waiting_list, mustpay,
        is_multi_offer, is_multi_offer_child,
        payload, last_synced_at, last_changed_at, payload_hash, is_deleted
    )
    SELECT
        e.offer_id, e.offer_number, e.name, e.category_ref, e.offerdef_ref, e.place_ref,
        e.date_start, e.date_end, e.date_signupstart, e.date_close,
        e.user_minimal, e.user_maximum, e.status, e.mode, e.offer_type,
        e.vat_rate, e.country, e.internal_code,
        coalesce(e.is_archived, false), coalesce(e.is_trash, false),
        e.has_waiting_list, e.mustpay, e.is_multi_offer, e.is_multi_offer_child,
        e.payload, now(), now(), e.payload_hash, false
    FROM eingang e
    ON CONFLICT (offer_id) DO UPDATE
    SET offer_number         = EXCLUDED.offer_number,
        name                 = EXCLUDED.name,
        category_ref         = EXCLUDED.category_ref,
        offerdef_ref         = EXCLUDED.offerdef_ref,
        place_ref            = EXCLUDED.place_ref,
        date_start           = EXCLUDED.date_start,
        date_end             = EXCLUDED.date_end,
        date_signupstart     = EXCLUDED.date_signupstart,
        date_close           = EXCLUDED.date_close,
        user_minimal         = EXCLUDED.user_minimal,
        user_maximum         = EXCLUDED.user_maximum,
        status               = EXCLUDED.status,
        mode                 = EXCLUDED.mode,
        offer_type           = EXCLUDED.offer_type,
        vat_rate             = EXCLUDED.vat_rate,
        country              = EXCLUDED.country,
        internal_code        = EXCLUDED.internal_code,
        is_archived          = EXCLUDED.is_archived,
        is_trash             = EXCLUDED.is_trash,
        has_waiting_list     = EXCLUDED.has_waiting_list,
        mustpay              = EXCLUDED.mustpay,
        is_multi_offer       = EXCLUDED.is_multi_offer,
        is_multi_offer_child = EXCLUDED.is_multi_offer_child,
        payload              = EXCLUDED.payload,
        last_synced_at       = now(),
        is_deleted           = false,
        last_changed_at      = CASE
                                   WHEN o.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.payload_hash
                                   THEN now() ELSE o.last_changed_at
                               END,
        payload_hash         = EXCLUDED.payload_hash
    RETURNING o.offer_id
),
fehlend AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.offer
    SET is_deleted = true, last_synced_at = now()
    WHERE is_deleted = false
      AND offer_id NOT IN (SELECT offer_id FROM eingang)
    RETURNING offer_id
),
lauf AS (
    UPDATE edoobox_raw.sync_run
    SET status           = 'erfolgreich',
        finished_at      = now(),
        bookings_seen    = (SELECT zeilen    FROM kennzahlen),
        bookings_changed = (SELECT geaendert FROM kennzahlen),
        api_calls        = {{ $json.abrufe }}
    WHERE run_id = {{ $json.run_id }}
    RETURNING run_id, status
)
SELECT
    (SELECT run_id FROM lauf)                 AS run_id,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM geschrieben)        AS angebote_gespeichert,
    (SELECT geaendert FROM kennzahlen)        AS inhaltlich_geaendert,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM fehlend)            AS als_geloescht_markiert,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
      WHERE b.is_deleted = false
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
                        WHERE o.offer_id = b.offer_id)) AS buchungen_ohne_angebot;
